ai.kinddesc.openrouter: One key for 30+ image models and many text models
ai.kinddesc.fal: Fast hosted open models, billed per image or megapixel
ai.kinddesc.openai: GPT Image and GPT with your own key
ai.kinddesc.google: Nano Banana image models, Gemini and Veo
ai.kinddesc.anthropic: Claude for script, translation and continuity (text only)
ai.kinddesc.replicate: Large catalogue and community fine-tunes; models may cold-start
ai.kinddesc.together: Open-weight image and text models, OpenAI-compatible
ai.kinddesc.runware: Low per-image cost for open-weight models
ai.kinddesc.huggingface: Any open checkpoint on an endpoint or the local worker
ai.kinddesc.ollama: Local text models for script, translation and routing
ai.kinddesc.openai_compatible: LiteLLM, vLLM, LM Studio or any OpenAI-format endpoint
ai.kinddesc.comfyui: Your own workflow, LoRA stack or ControlNet setup
ai.kinddesc.http: Any REST image API: request template and response path
ai.kinddesc.local_worker: A GPU machine running the MangaVeyra worker
ai.kinddesc.placeholder: Labelled screentone art and template text, no AI

ai.reason.spend_limit: over the monthly remote spend limit ({remaining} left)
ai.reason.new_custom: new custom model, waiting for results
ai.reason.balanced: best balance of quality, speed and cost
ai.reason.licence_warning: non-commercial licence on a {series} series (licence guard is off)

ai.reason.no_refs.other: no reference or LoRA support for {count} locked characters
ai.pin.scope_id_hint: Series or project slug, character id, panel type (cover, splash) or job type
ai.pin.label: Name shown
ai.pin.mode_hint: A mode pin such as Local only keeps a whole series on this server.
ai.models.title: Models & providers
ai.models.empty.title: No models of this kind yet
ai.models.empty.body: Connect a provider or a worker and its models show up here.
ai.models.only_placeholder: Only the built-in placeholder is connected: every result is labelled placeholder art or template text. Add a provider or a worker for real models.
ai.local_only.on: Local only mode is on: nothing leaves this server
ai.changes.title: Catalogue changes
ai.changes.sub: Manifests added, updated or removed since you last looked. Any model can be turned off server-wide.
ai.routing.title: Routing
ai.routing.sub: How jobs pick a model on this server
ai.routing.note_local_only: Local only mode is on, so every job stays on this server.
ai.routing.note_member: Your own mode. The server default is {mode}; project and series pins still apply.
ai.routing.empty.title: No routing decisions yet
ai.routing.empty.body: Generate a panel and every pick shows up here with its reason.
ai.routing.pins_empty: No pins. Pin a model to a character, panel type, project or series.
ai.guard.licence: Licence guard (non-commercial models on public series)
ai.guard.spent: This month on your own keys: {server} on the server, {mine} by you
ai.guard.users: Users may add their own providers
ai.chooser.title: Add a provider
ai.chooser.sub: Keys are encrypted and never shown again after saving.
ai.wizard.name: Name
ai.wizard.url_hint.ollama: The Ollama server, usually on port 11434.
ai.wizard.url_hint.comfyui: The ComfyUI server, usually on port 8188.
ai.wizard.url_hint.compat: The API root including its version, for example http://host:8000/v1.
ai.wizard.url_hint.hf: Leave empty to use Hugging Face's serverless inference, or run it in the local worker.
ai.wizard.url_hint.http: The endpoint that receives the request body below.
ai.wizard.key_hint: Encrypted at rest and never shown again after saving.
ai.wizard.key_saved: Key saved (ends in {hint}). Leave empty to keep it.
ai.wizard.key_note: Keys are encrypted with this server's master key. Local only mode blocks every remote provider, including this one.
ai.wizard.private_note: Addresses on your own network are allowed when an admin connects the provider or approves it.
ai.wizard.model_id_hint: The model the endpoint serves, as its API expects it.
ai.wizard.hf_model_hint: The Hugging Face repository, for example Qwen/Qwen-Image.
ai.wizard.workflow_hint: Export it in ComfyUI with “Save (API Format)”.
ai.wizard.what.test: Test: a sample prompt shows the image or text, the time and any reported cost.
ai.wizard.what.describe: Describe: tick what it can do, or let the provider's model list fill it in.
ai.wizard.what.route: Route: it joins the catalogue and auto-routing can pick it.
ai.manage.title: Manage this provider
ai.manage.remove_note: Its saved key and its custom models are deleted. Jobs already done keep their results.
ai.http.body_hint: JSON with placeholders in double braces: prompt, negative, width, height, seed, n, model and image (a data URI).
ai.http.result_path_hint: A dotted path in the response, for example data.0.b64_json.
ai.test.title: Test result
ai.test.caption: TEST IMAGE · “{prompt}”
ai.describe.served_note: These join routing automatically with their published capabilities and costs.
ai.describe.discovered: More models from the provider's list
ai.describe.discovered_note: Tick models to add them; their capabilities are filled in from the provider.
ai.describe.discover_failed: The model list could not be read: {why}
ai.describe.name: Model name
ai.describe.id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot and dash.
ai.describe.cost: Cost per image on your key
ai.describe.cost_hint: Used for estimates and the compute meter when the provider publishes none.
ai.describe.commercial: Outputs may be used commercially (the licence guard uses this)
ai.describe.manifest_hint: Same format as the built-in catalogue; its providers are replaced by this connection.
ai.describe.aside: New custom models start at neutral scores and are picked automatically once they have results, unless you pin them.
ai.route.neutral: It starts at neutral scores and auto-routing picks it once it has results. Pin it to use it right away.
ai.route.catalogue: These models now compete in routing on quality, speed and cost; the router also picks the cheapest or fastest provider serving each one.
ai.route.aside: You can turn it off, test it again or remove it from Models & providers at any time.
ai.workers.title: Local workers
ai.workers.sub: Workers pull jobs from this server; the server never connects to them.
ai.workers.name: Worker name
ai.workers.name_hint: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore, for example studio-pc.
ai.workers.once: Copy it now: it is shown only once. Start the worker with one of the commands below.
ai.workers.aside: Workers download model weights on first use and advertise only models that fit their GPU. Set MV_MODELS to limit them to your local set.
ai.local.title: Local models
ai.local.no_gpu: No GPU worker yet: sizes are shown for planning
ai.local.no_worker: No worker is online. Start one to run local models.
ai.local.saved: Local set saved. Restart workers with the command below to use it.
ai.local.how: Workers fetch the weights from Hugging Face on first use. `check` lists what a worker can run without starting it.
ai.meter.remote_limit: {spent} of {limit} this month · your own keys
ai.error.name: Enter a name (up to 80 characters).
ai.error.url_blocked: This address is not allowed. Use an https URL on the internet.
ai.error.url_private: This is an address on a private network. An admin must connect it, or set MV_ALLOW_PRIVATE_PROVIDER_URLS.
ai.error.model_taken: Another model already uses this id.
ai.error.model_id: Use lowercase letters, digits, dot and dash.
ai.error.workflow_missing: Upload the workflow exported with “Save (API Format)”.
ai.error.hf_model: Enter the Hugging Face model id.
ai.error.amount: Enter an amount such as 10 or 12.50.
ai.error.worker_name: Use letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only.
ai.error.pin_scope_id: Say which project, series, character, panel type or job type.
ai.error.pin_model: Choose a model or a mode.
